steps.name: Grandpa
steps.text: Stupid, foolish boy...

steps.name: Grandpa
steps.text: You didn't have to do this.

steps.name: Grandpa
steps.text: Why would you go so far for a world that owes you so much?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Sir?!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You must leave now! Originium activity is rising rapidly in this area!

steps.name: Grandpa
steps.text: I want to see my grandson one last time.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Only a little further, Hibiscus. Distract him...

steps.name: Grandpa
steps.text: Kreide, grandpa's here.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Grandpa
steps.text: Kreide, my boy.

steps.name: Grandpa
steps.text: Vent whatever anger you have on me.

steps.name: Grandpa
steps.text: Come to me, before you do any more harm!

steps.name: Grandpa
steps.text: I've deceived you for so many years... I thought about dying for your sake, but I never thought you would come to an end like this.

steps.name: Grandpa
steps.text: If your choice is to let the others live, why not let me come with you in my last days?

steps.name: Grandpa
steps.text: Let me join you on your final journey, my boy!
The crystalline monster no longer understands the old man's words.
The flash of lucidity was a fleeting miracle. All the monster can think about now is dragging everything around it into emptiness, dancing to his cello's tune.
The monster follows the sound, playing a song of death.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Sir?!

steps.name: Grandpa
steps.text: Young lady, why do you—

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'll hold down the fort here, Ebenholz. Now!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Ha!

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: How?!

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Friendship, dedication, sacrifice—such childish ideals should have been shattered upon contact with reality. How? How?!

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: It's not over yet!

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Kreide may have forcibly assimilated two verses of the Voice of Mundane, but he could not overcome the disorder and madness of their amalgamation!

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Kreide's melody has faded, but Ebenholz's Voice lingers. I—

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Argh!

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Enough, Gräfin Strollo.
Gertrude's limp hand drops from the strings.
Biegler withdraws his dagger from Gertrude's back. The blood stains his clothes red.
The Originium outer shell cracks and falls apart.
The plaza falls silent, the only sound being inert pieces of Originium shell falling to the ground.
Finally, the shell shatters completely, leaving behind Kreide lying on the ground with his cello.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Wait for me... wait for me!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: No! It's dangerous. We should call Infected Palliative Services...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: What are you saying?!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Kreide won't die!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You're awake, Kreide!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: See? He'll be fine!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Ebenholz...?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'm here, it's me!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Don't... don't bother. I...

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: (Takes a deep breath)

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I feel... so light...

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: It hurt so much... but I feel better now...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Yes, you'll get better... yes...

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Listen carefully, Ebenholz. This is the last time I'll be able to talk to you.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Remember my words.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Live on, Ebenholz, and walk through the long night.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Fight injustice, and treat others with generosity and charity.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Only by doing so will I live on in your memory.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I'll ask you, how did your day go, Ebenholz?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: And you'll tell me proudly that you had a good and productive day.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: You'll tell me about the challenges you face while doing good, and complain about how fate is a miser.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: And it will be okay, because I'll be listening.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: It's alright to complain a little, when you've worked so hard.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Only by doing so will you rise above pain and suffering, and find peace in your heart.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Remember that we've fought together against cruel fate and won.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: When you think of me, laugh. Don't cry.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Yes, yes!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: And Ebenholz... I'm sorry.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I haven't thought about what token... to give you...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Anything's fine. Just don't die... please...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Kreide... Kreide...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Kreide!!!

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: They'll find themselves shattered someday, but that day is not today.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Friendship, dedication, sacrifice...

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: They may be naive, but someone will shed a tear for them.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: What about you, though, Gräfin Strollo?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: You destroyed your friendship with Czerny by your own hands.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: You killed your own brother and laughed at his incompetence.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: You want others to sacrifice for you, but what have you done for them?

a.text: Gertrude lies limp on the ground, with only her lips moving slightly.
'May you die in a dark ditch.'
'May the madness of Ebenholz's bloodline haunt him forever.'
'May Leithanien ever tremble in the shadow of the Witch King.'
'May the Witch King never know the peace of death.'

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Pathetic.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Maybe I acted out of impulse, but dealing with threats to public safety is also part of my job.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: I'll be sure to mention you in my report, Gräfin Strollo.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Good night. I hope your dreams don't involve cursing anybody.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Your hand's bleeding! Did you get scratched by Originium crystals?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Ah, yes... I guess there's a bit of blood...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You need treatment immediately—

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Treatment? It's Kreide who needs treatment!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Ebenholz, he's...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Don't.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Don't say it, Hibiscus. I beg you...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: He... he's Infected, Ebenholz. If you don't want Palliative Services to get involved, at least find a room that's isolated, for his own sake.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I know, I know...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: The lounge at the concert hall.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Alright, I'll take him there.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Come, Kreide. I'll carry you.
Ebenholz lifts Kreide up. The Originium crystals inflict more wounds on him, but he pays them no heed.
He carries his friend, even as he feels the body cooling, as though embracing a short but sweet dream.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: We're almost there, Kreide.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Just a little longer.

steps.name: Kreide?
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You're—You're still alive!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'll take you to Hibiscus—

steps.name: Kreide?
steps.text: Lay me to rest in this building.

steps.name: Kreide?
steps.text: If you return to The Afterglow someday, you'll remember that you once had a good friend, with whom you've laughed and argued here...

steps.name: Kreide?
steps.text: And at the last, put on a duet to remember.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: No. You're not Kreide. You're—

steps.name: Kreide?
steps.text: Isn't this what you wanted?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Shut your mouth. I won't allow you to defile his memory.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Kreide gave his life to cleanse the Voice of Mundane, but it's still in my head?!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I warn you... don't think I'll hesitate to blow my own head off, if you dare imitate him one more time.

steps.name: The Voice in His Head
steps.text: (Sighs)

steps.name: The Voice in His Head
steps.text: My foolish bloodline.
Ebenholz no longer hears the voice.
He walks toward the lounge in Afterglow Hall, Kreide's body growing heavier in his arms with each step.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: We're here.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'll seal the room. Lie down on the sofa.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: It's soft. It'll feel nice.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Sofa, soft...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You've never slept on one at home...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Looks like I've been infected.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Arts that once took so much effort now feel so simple. Maybe getting infected isn't so bad after all.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: That should do it. I'll seal the door from the outside.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Anything else?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: A token... yes, a token.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'll take the cello.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Look at me, taking back something I bought for you.
Ebenholz's lips tremble.
He stands wordless for a moment before laying his flute at Kreide's side.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You said you wanted a coin with a hole, but the only thing I have left is this flute...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: So sorry...
